summary: Iteration 3 (backend-only). Verified Phase B-2 deploy script fix in /app/backend/deploy_agent_engine.py and re-ran the serving-backend golden path. All checks pass. Deploy script is not executed here (requires GCP creds + deploy libs; runs in user's Cloud Shell), only statically validated.
critical_code_review_comments: Deploy script fix is correct and minimal: os.chdir before importing adk_app ensures cloudpickle can locate the package; extra_packages=['adk_app'] guarantees dependencies.tar.gz ships the module (fixes 46-byte empty archive → ModuleNotFoundError on Vertex Agent Engine).
Serving backend correctly does NOT import adk_app or deploy_agent_engine at runtime — edit has zero blast radius on the FastAPI process.
DEV fallbacks (emergent-proxy for reasoning, Parallel not_connected, Vertex/Agent Builder not_connected) are all surfaced honestly in agent-runs and health endpoints — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 throwaway experience e5c94b0c-488a-4a69-b322-7ec3915fb7e6 to exercise the /plan pipeline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deploy script (/app/backend/deploy_agent_engine.py) is a Cloud-Shell-only artifact and must never be executed in this container. Static AST verification is sufficient. Serving backend golden path (agent/health, partner/health, auth/me, /plan bilingual output with missions, agent-runs with compliance trace) all pass; planning latency observed <30s via Emergent Gemini proxy.
rca of the issue: Original bug: cloudpickle serialized root_agent by reference to a local 'adk_app' module that wasn't shipped, so Vertex Agent Engine's staged dependencies.tar.gz was ~46 bytes and the runtime raised ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'adk_app'. Fix: (1) os.chdir(Path(__file__).parent) as first line of main() so relative imports/resolution anchor to /app/backend, and (2) extra_packages=['adk_app'] in agent_engines.create(...) so the ADK package is uploaded with the deployment. Both changes are present and verified via ast.parse.
